scripts.translation: 按樓層查詢魔物

scripts.text: Monster Information Retrieval System
scripts.translation: 怪物資訊檢索系統

scripts.text: Request
scripts.translation: 提交請求

scripts.text: Cancel

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
This is Monster Information Retrieval System. Information of the monsters that appear in this dungeon can be searched. Enter Monster Name, including spaces, when searching.
scripts.translation:
[魔物資訊檢索系統]
這裡是魔物資訊檢索系統，可查詢當前迷宮中出現的魔物。搜尋時請輸入魔物名稱，包括名稱中的空格。

In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --

為了讓冒險者輕鬆愉快地環遊世界，我們將各地冒險者收集到的資訊公之於眾。
如有資訊需要補充或修正，請告知冒險者團體。
-- 冒險者團體 --

Nogg road is a B2 dungeon that houses fierce monsters. Inexperienced adventurer should not enter this place. Furthermore roads within the dungeon are very narrow, so be careful to not cause inconvenience to other players.
scripts.translation:
[熔岩地下城]
熔岩地下城 B2 棲息著兇猛的魔物，不適合沒有經驗的冒險者前往。
另外，地下城里的通道非常狹窄，請小心行走，避免妨礙其他玩家。

[Mjolnir Dead Pit]
In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --
scripts.translation:
[妙勒尼爾廢棄礦坑]
為了讓冒險者輕鬆愉快地環遊世界，我們將各地冒險者收集到的資訊公之於眾。
如有資訊需要補充或修正，請告知冒險者團體。
-- 冒險者團體 --

[迷宮森林]
為了讓冒險者輕鬆愉快地環遊世界，我們將各地冒險者收集到的資訊公之於眾。
如有資訊需要補充或修正，請告知冒險者團體。
-- 冒險者團體 --

scripts.text:
[Orc Dungeon]
Orc Dungeon is comprised of 2 floors. Monsters that appear in this dungeon are not strong individually, but adventurers may be overwhelmed by the number. Holy element weapons will make adventurer's life easier in this dungeon. You can also utilize Priest skill, Aspersio.
scripts.translation:
[獸人地下城]
獸人地下城共有2層。這裡的魔物單體並不強，但常常成群出現，冒險者可能招架不住。
使用聖屬性武器，或服用牧師技能“灑水祈福”賦予武器聖屬性，會更容易應對。

In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --

[Izlude Undersea Tunnel]
Byalan Island's Undersea Tunnel is comprised of 6 floors. This dungeon is appropriate for beginners to expert adventurers. Most monsters in this dungeon are water element, therefore having wind element weapons will prove to be helpful.

如需查詢更多魔物資訊，請使用魔物資訊檢索系統。

scripts.text:
[Sunken Ship]
In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --
scripts.translation:
[沉船]
為了讓冒險者輕鬆愉快地環遊世界，我們將各地冒險者收集到的資訊公之於眾。
如有資訊需要補充或修正，請告知冒險者團體。
-- 冒險者團體 --

scripts.text: Look up monsters by floor
scripts.translation: 按樓層查詢魔物

scripts.text: Monster Information Retrieval System
scripts.translation: 怪物資訊檢索系統

scripts.text: Request
scripts.translation: 提交請求

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Requested information will appear - There's no problem if it appears
scripts.translation: 請求的資訊將顯示在這裡。只要能正常顯示，就沒有問題。

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
This is Monster Information Retrieval System. Information of the monsters that appear in this dungeon can be searched. Enter Monster Name, including spaces, when searching.
scripts.translation:
[魔物資訊檢索系統]
這裡是魔物資訊檢索系統，可查詢當前迷宮中出現的魔物。搜尋時請輸入魔物名稱，包括名稱中的空格。

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
Now searching
scripts.translation:
[魔物資訊檢索系統]
正在搜尋...

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
Search has been completed.
Now showing the search results.
scripts.translation:
[魔物資訊檢索系統]
搜尋完成。
正在顯示搜尋結果。

[Comodo East Cave, Mao]
East Cave, Mao is a tunnel that leads to Papuchicha Forest. This place is popular for highly sought after cards, Thara Frog and Hydra. Visit this place if you are in dire need of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[克魔島東洞·茂]
茂洞是一條通往普勒斯特森林的隧道。達拉蛙卡片和海葵卡片很受歡迎，急需Zeny的話不妨來這裡碰碰運氣。

scripts.text:
[Comodo East Cave, Mao]
------------ Monster ------------
Hydra(34)
Thara Frog(40)
Megalodon(46)
Nereid(98)
--------------------------------
<Thara Frog.. It's just a frog right? Ew.. It looks hideous.. - Frog loving Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <達拉蛙...它只是一隻青蛙對吧？嘔...它看起來很醜陋... - 喜愛青蛙的探險家葡萄>

scripts.text:
[Comodo West Cave, Karu]
In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --
scripts.translation:
[克魔島西洞·卡魯]

如有資訊需要補充或修正，請告知冒險者團體。
-- 冒險者團體 --

scripts.text:
[Comodo West Cave, Karu]
This dungeon introduces Medusa monster that will surely cause you to turn to stone if you look at it in the eyes. There are no other exits in this cave.
scripts.translation:
[克魔島西洞·卡魯]
這裡棲息著米杜沙。只要直視它的眼睛，就會變成石頭。
這座洞穴沒有其他出口。

scripts.text: <Tao Gunka? That monster with huge face? How strong is it? It's weak.. very weak.. Oh!! It might be strong for you.. - Trolling Explorer Grape>
scripts.translation: <塔奧群卡？就是那個大臉魔物嗎？它有多強？弱得很...真的很弱...哦！！對你來說可能挺強...——愛捉弄人的探險家葡萄>

scripts.text:
[Comodo North Cave, Ruande]
In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --
scripts.translation:
[克魔島北洞·魯安德]
為了讓冒險者輕鬆愉快地環遊世界，我們將各地冒險者收集到的資訊公之於眾。
如有資訊需要補充或修正，請告知冒險者團體。
-- 冒險者團體 --

[Comodo North Cave, Ruande]
------------ Monster ------------
Hydra(34)

[Odin Temple]
In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --

為了讓冒險者輕鬆愉快地環遊世界，我們將各地冒險者收集到的資訊公之於眾。
如有資訊需要補充或修正，請告知冒險者團體。
-- 冒險者團體 --

In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --
scripts.translation:
[星光礁]
為了讓冒險者輕鬆愉快地環遊世界，我們將各地冒險者收集到的資訊公之於眾。
如有資訊需要補充或修正，請告知冒險者團體。
-- 冒險者團體 --

scripts.text: Look up monsters by floor
scripts.translation: 按樓層查詢魔物

scripts.text: Monster Information Retrieval System
scripts.translation: 怪物資訊檢索系統

scripts.text: Request
scripts.translation: 提交請求

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Requested information will appear - There's no problem if it appears
scripts.translation: 請求的資訊將顯示在這裡。只要能正常顯示，就沒有問題。

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
This is Monster Information Retrieval System. Information of the monsters that appear in this dungeon can be searched. Enter Monster Name, including spaces, when searching.
scripts.translation:
[魔物資訊檢索系統]
這裡是魔物資訊檢索系統，可查詢當前迷宮中出現的魔物。搜尋時請輸入魔物名稱，包括名稱中的空格。

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
Now searching
scripts.translation:
[魔物資訊檢索系統]
正在搜尋...

scripts.text:
[Monster Information Retrieval System]
Search has been completed.
Now showing the search results.
scripts.translation:
[魔物資訊檢索系統]
搜尋完成。
正在顯示搜尋結果。

[Turtle Island]
In order for Adventurers to travel all over the world for a relaxing adventure, Information gathered from various adventurers are made public. Please provide information tips to the adventurer group to revise the information.
-- Adventurer Group --

[海龜島]

如有資訊需要補充或修正，請告知冒險者團體。
-- 冒險者團體 --
